date_note: Date is the article's publication day; the article says CrowdStrike announced it that day (Monday).
title: CrowdStrike announces acquisition of Zscaler in a stock deal
summary: Geektime, Help Net Security and IBTimes report that CrowdStrike announced on Monday it will acquire Zscaler in an all-stock deal. Help Net Security puts the enterprise value at about $43.9 billion; IBTimes says approximately $43.9 billion. Closing is expected in the second half of CrowdStrike's fiscal 2028, subject to regulatory approval and Zscaler shareholder approval, and both boards approved it.
plain: Geektime, Help Net Security and IBTimes report CrowdStrike will buy Zscaler in an all-stock deal valued at about $43.9 billion, subject to approvals.
exec: Two security vendors plan to combine in a deal reported at about $43.9 billion.
